audit_metadata.evaluation_standard: Reset Lifecycle, Error Retention & Retry Mechanics, Spec Naming Conformance

test_cases.description: Verify components retain 100% draggable capability after clicking 'Reset Simulation' and re-assembling multiple times.
test_cases.findings: Global listeners bound once to the document nodes. resetSimulation() restores initial state (currentStepIndex = 0, clears installed set), properly calls updateGuidanceUI() which sets draggable='true' and .active-target on Step 1 (Motherboard). Verified no listener leaks or lost event bindings.

test_cases.description: Ensure dropped items into incorrect slots or out-of-order attempts NEVER advance the step index and allow infinite retries.
test_cases.findings: validateAndSeatComponent() enforces strict equality checks (droppedId === targetSlotComponent && droppedId === currentExpected.id). Any mismatch triggers triggerErrorFeedback(), plays error buzz, snaps back to palette, and preserves currentStepIndex.

test_cases.description: Verify shake animation and accurate toast message ('Incorrect slot, try again') upon invalid drop or click.
test_cases.findings: DOM reflow trick ('void element.offsetWidth') reliably restarts the CSS shake-error animation on rapid successive errors; toast displays 'Incorrect slot, try again'.

test_cases.description: Audit all UI labels, tooltips, placeholders, and guidance copy for strict conformance to simplified names: Motherboard, PSU, RAM, SSD, RTX 4060, Case.
test_cases.findings: All labels updated in pc-builder.html and pc-builder.js across headers, inventory cards, slots, and summary pills.

test_cases.description: Confirm Step 5 (RTX 4060) completion triggers the victory modal, checkmark animation, and 'POWER: ACTIVE (100% POST)'.
test_cases.findings: completeAssembly() successfully transitions the chassis status LED to green and presents the victory modal with zero console errors.

test_cases.description: Confirm tap-to-seat handles clicks smoothly when drag-and-drop is unavailable or awkward on mobile touchscreens.
test_cases.findings: handleCardClick() respects the identical strict step validation as drag-and-drop, allowing full mobile usability.
